comments.author: SirDigby
comments.body_html:
Realism doesn’t have a formal version for 3.11 and that’s the point, it’s currently in TESTING. At the very least you should include a disclaimer/warning in your description that people using your patch SHOULD NOT be forwarding bug reports to Fontaine regarding Realism if they are using your mod. All this does is create the potential for false reports about bugs that could be introduced with your patch, something I’m sure Fontaine WOULD NOT appreciate and I don’t think releasing patches or additions to mods that are IN TESTING should be encouraged or allowed, similar to the no mods policy on Bleeding Edge SPT, but that’s just my opinion.

Like I said, a warning/disclaimer in your description page regarding bug reports is required in this case as it has the potential to not only create extra work for both you and Fontaine, it may also create delays in the release of an official 3.11 version of Realism.

I hope you understand this concern.
